name: Kouign-Amann
summary: Laminated with sugar. Caramelised, crunchy, obscene.

steps.text: Make a simple lean dough and chill.
Lock in butter, then fold with sugar dusted into each turn.
Cut squares, fold corners in, place in buttered rings.
Proof, then bake until the sugar runs dark.

bake.notes: Bake on a lined tray. The caramel will run and it will burn onto bare metal.

notes: The sugar folds are what makes it. Do not be shy with them.
